title: Marvion
description: A lightweight, high-performance optimization and combat-focused modpack for Fabric 1.21.4.
body:
# Marvion

A lightweight, high-performance optimization and combat-focused modpack for Minecraft 1.21.4, built on the Fabric loader.

This collection bridges the gap between raw rendering performance and precise combat mechanics. By stripping away unnecessary bloat, it delivers maximum frames-per-second alongside heavily optimized shield responsiveness, hit registration, and tactical visual feedback.

---

## ⚡ Key Features

* **Elite Performance:** Powered by **Sodium** and **Sodium Extra** for massive FPS boosts, stutter reduction, and detailed graphical fine-tuning.
* **Overhauled Shield Mechanics:** Completely re-engineers how shields look, behave, and sound. Fixes visual clipping glitches, adds real-time HUD durability indicators, and integrates premium audio feedback.
* **Competitive Hit Accuracy:** Integrates refined client-side hit registration tweaks and precise combat hitbox tracking for cleaner, more reliable engagement scaling in PvP and PvE.
* **Clean Client UI:** Keeps the vanilla aesthetic intact while giving you complete control over your setup via an intuitive in-game **ModMenu**.

---

## 📦 Included Blueprint List

| Mod Component | Category | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **Sodium** | Performance | Modern, highly optimized rendering engine replacing the vanilla engine. |
| **Sodium Extra** | Performance | Unlocks advanced optimization tweaks and extra visual toggles. |
| **Fabric API** | Core | Essential core library hooks for modern Fabric mod functionality. |
| **ModMenu** | UI / QoL | Adds an organized screen to view and configure your active mods. |
| **BactroMod** | Enhancement | A collection of minor client-side tweaks designed to smooth out gameplay. |
| **Shield Status+** | HUD / Tactical | Places dynamic, real-time durability tracking directly on your interface. |
| **Complete Shield Fixes** | Bug Fix | Fixes legacy positioning, holding, and blocking animation errors. |
| **Better Hitreg** | Optimization | Smooths out network interaction for cleaner hit detection. |
| **Combat Hitboxes** | Tactical | Provides clear, non-intrusive layout indicators for competitive contexts. |
| **Better Shield Sounds** | Resource Pack | Replaces the hollow vanilla block noise with a rich metallic impact. |

---

* **Target Version:** Minecraft 1.21.4
* **Mod Loader:** Fabric
* **Server Compatibility:** 100% Client-side. Safe to use on all vanilla servers, realms, and public competitive networks.
